name: app-and-report-with-ai
description: The orchestrator's build, checks and published pages. The language, the generator and both CLIs are at the root of this repository; the reporting platform is yaml/enterprise_reporting_rust.

scripts.check: bun run check:models && bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run check:language-tools && bun run check:stacks && bun run check:clis && bun run check:pack
scripts._comment:clis: Two CLIs, two toolchains: `appwithai` is the TypeScript pipeline run by bun, `appwithai-gen` the Rust generator run by cargo. `check:clis` runs both, which needs cargo on PATH; CI gives the Rust one its own job with a Rust toolchain — see .github/workflows/root-ci.yml.
scripts._comment:lint: biome.json here is the lint config, marked root so the repository root's own config does not govern this directory's scripts.
scripts._comment:language-tools: html/model-yaml.js (the YAML reader, schema, checker and fixer) and html/assets/appwithai-model.js (the reader and compiler that feed the vendored browser generators) are bundled from language/browser/*.entry.ts at the root of this repository. `--check` runs in `check` and fails rather than serving a validator that disagrees with the language.
